description: 非官方《魔兽世界》吉安娜·普罗德摩尔同人桌宠：白金长发、蓝白金法袍、水晶法杖与冰霜魔法，包含九种生动状态。Unofficial Warcraft fan art of Jaina Proudmoore: a chibi archmage with blue-white-gold robes, crystal staff and frost magic in nine animated states. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard Entertainment or the rights holders.
